→ I03 assortment + planogram optimizer" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="480" x="20" y="156" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="loop" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="R01 adds MOBILITY and nothing else.

→ Kafka, schema registered in Apicurio" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="500" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ou1" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;" value="stock-service
count vs system stock → reconciliation task with a bay thumbnail" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="500" x="20" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ou2" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;" value="I03 planogram
compliance deviation → merchandising task" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="500" x="20" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ou3" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="⭐ PROMOTION-ERROR DETECTION — the sleeper feature
shelf/ESL label price vs price-service

Simbe's ten-year headline is 80M PROMOTION ERRORS FIXED,
not gaps found. A wrong label is a direct margin leak, it is
trivially detectable once you can read the label, and NO OTHER
PLAN IN THE FIVE FOLDERS CATCHES IT." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="118" width="500" x="20" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ou4" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" value="Grafana — availability % · gap-hours per aisle
scan coverage · promotion errors found" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="500" x="20" y="346" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="scope" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="Four scoping decisions that make this shippable

1 · OFF-PEAK ONLY. ~36 in clear aisle required, and SLAM literature is explicit that
 "mainstream methods assume static environments" — a trading-hours aisle is worse than a warehouse.
2 · 2D SLAM, not 3D. Cartographer/AMCL on a flat floor. FAST-LIO2 earns its keep with ramps; a store has none.
3 · RENT OR BORROW ONE UNIT. Do not buy a fleet for a contest. Vendors lend demo units — ask.
4 · REPORT PRECISION AT THE AUTO-ACCEPT THRESHOLD, not top-1 accuracy. The operating point is the deliverable,
 with C05's three-way decision: identified / confirm / unknown — and "unknown" is a valid, correct output." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="1100" x="40" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="risk" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="THE #1 RISK

Catalogue images are studio
renders on white.
Shelf images are not.

Measure gallery quality BEFORE
promising accuracy. Add in-store
gallery images per SKU — the
gallery can mix sources.

98%+ is Simbe's number for
TRAINED SKUs, not ours." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="270" x="1200" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="first" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="Phase 0 — SIMULATE FIRST (R06)

Route, coverage and scan-time
estimates come out of the twin.

Rent the robot only AFTER the twin
says the route works.

Costs zero extra days — R06 already
models this store." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="240" x="1500" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;dashed=1;" value="Licence position: PaddleClas Apache-2.0 · PaddleDetection Apache-2.0 · RT-DETRv2 Apache-2.0 · ByteTrack MIT · Cartographer Apache-2.0 (verify) · Open-RMF Apache-2.0. No AGPL, no non-commercial weights.
Privacy: products only, no faces, metadata-only egress, signage — the same rules as V04. Bootstrap on SKU-110K / RP2K / Products-10K before collecting a single in-store image." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1700" x="40" y="850" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="robot" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=3;exitX=1;exitY=0.3;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="three" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="three" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=3;exitX=1;exitY=0.3;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.2;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;fontSize=10;" target="out" value="metadata only"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="three" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="loop" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Four scoping decisions that make this shippable
1 · OFF-PEAK ONLY. ~36 in clear aisle required, and SLAM literature is explicit that
"mainstream methods assume static environments" — a trading-hours aisle is worse than a warehouse.
2 · 2D SLAM, not 3D. Cartographer/AMCL on a flat floor. FAST-LIO2 earns its keep with ramps; a store has none.
3 · RENT OR BORROW ONE UNIT. Do not buy a fleet for a contest. Vendors lend demo units — ask.
4 · REPORT PRECISION AT THE AUTO-ACCEPT THRESHOLD, not top-1 accuracy. The operating point is the deliverable,
with C05's three-way decision: identified / confirm / unknown — and "unknown" is a valid, correct output.

div.div:
THE #1 RISK
Catalogue images are studio
renders on white.
Shelf images are not.
Measure gallery quality BEFORE
promising accuracy. Add in-store
gallery images per SKU — the
gallery can mix sources.
98%+ is Simbe's number for
TRAINED SKUs, not ours.

div.div:
Phase 0 — SIMULATE FIRST (R06)
Route, coverage and scan-time
estimates come out of the twin.
Rent the robot only AFTER the twin
says the route works.
Costs zero extra days — R06 already
models this store.
